Abstract
blocks.translated: 摘要

blocks.text: Link prediction is a fundamental task of graph machine learning, and Graph Neural Network (GNN) based methods have become the mainstream approach due to their good performance. However, the typical practice learns node representations through neighborhood aggregation, lacking awareness of the structural relationships between target nodes. Recently, some methods have attempted to address this issue by node labeling tricks. However, they still rely on the node-centric neighborhood message passing of GNNs, which we believe involves two limitations in terms of information perception and transmission for link prediction. First, it cannot perceive long-range structural information due to the restricted receptive fields. Second, there may be information loss of nodecentric model on link-centric task. In addition, we empirically find that the neighbor node features could introduce noise for link prediction. To address these issues, we propose a structural information enhanced link prediction framework, which involves removing the neighbor node features while fitting neighborhood graph structures more focused through GNN. Furthermore, we introduce Binary Structural Transformer (BST) to encode the structural relationships between target nodes, complementing the deficiency of GNN. Our approach achieves remarkable results on multiple popular benchmarks, including ranking first on ogbl-ppa, ogblcitation2 and Pubmed.
blocks.translated: 链接预测是图机器学习的一项基础任务，基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法因其良好性能已成为主流方法。然而，典型做法通过邻域聚合学习节点表示，缺乏对目标节点之间结构关系的感知。最近，一些方法尝试通过节点标记技巧解决该问题。然而，它们仍依赖GNN的节点中心邻域消息传递，我们认为这在链接预测的信息感知和传递方面存在两个局限。首先，由于感受野受限，无法感知长程结构信息。其次，节点中心模型在链接中心任务上可能存在信息损失。此外，我们通过实验发现，邻居节点特征可能为链接预测引入噪声。为解决这些问题，我们提出结构信息增强的链接预测框架，该框架去除邻居节点特征，同时通过GNN更聚焦地拟合邻域图结构。此外，我们引入Binary Structural Transformer（BST）来编码目标节点之间的结构关系，以补充GNN的不足。我们的方法在多个流行基准数据集上取得了显著结果，包括在ogbl-ppa、ogblcitation2和Pubmed上排名第一。

blocks.text: Introduction
blocks.translated: 引言

blocks.text: Link prediction is the task of predicting missing or potential edges according to existing nodes and edges in a graph, the typical applications of which include knowledge completion, recommendation, and more. For example, it can complete missing colleague relationships, and city of birth for a person, or can predict users’ interest in certain products in a recommendation system. There are various methods for link prediction, among which Graph Neural Network (GNN) based methods have become the mainstream ones due to their good performance and efficiency.
blocks.translated: 链接预测是根据图中已有的节点和边来预测缺失边或潜在边的任务，其典型应用包括知识补全、推荐等。例如，它可以补全缺失的同事关系以及一个人的出生城市，或者可以在推荐系统中预测用户对某些产品的兴趣。链接预测的方法多种多样，其中基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法因其良好的性能和效率已成为主流方法。

blocks.text: GNNs (Kipf and Welling 2016a; Hamilton, Ying, and Leskovec 2017; Velikovi et al. 2017) have achieved great results in a lot of fields. They are centered on a certain node, and aggregate features of neighbor nodes and edges to the central node through the Message Passing (MP) (Gilmer et al. 2017), which are good at learning node representations. When applied to link prediction, the typical practice is to use the Autoencoder framework on Graph (GAE (Kipf and Welling 2016b)). This involves encoding individual node representations with GNNs, aggregating representations of the target nodes, and decoding them into link probability.
blocks.translated: 图神经网络（GNN）（Kipf and Welling 2016a；Hamilton, Ying, and Leskovec 2017；Velikovi et al. 2017）已在众多领域取得了优异成果。此类方法以某一节点为中心，通过消息传递（MP）(Gilmer et al. 2017)将邻居节点与边的特征聚合至中心节点，擅长学习节点表示。将其应用于链接预测时，典型做法是在图上采用自编码器框架（GAE (Kipf and Welling 2016b)）。该做法包括：利用GNN编码各个节点的表示，聚合目标节点的表示，并将其解码为链接概率。

However, such an approach may miss some important features for link prediction. A simple example is illustrated in Fig. 1-(a), where nodes h1 and h2 are isomorphic. Without node features, GNN learns the same node representation, resulting in the same link representation of pair (h1, t) and pair (h2, t). In fact, the results should not be the same. Node h2 and t share a common neighbor, indicating a higher probability of a link. We believe that GAEs fail fundamentally because they focus on capturing neighbor information centered on nodes during the encoding stage, without perceiving the structural relationships of target node pairs.
blocks.translated: 然而，这类方法可能会遗漏链接预测中的一些重要特征。Fig. 1-(a) 给出了一个简单示例，其中节点 h1 与 h2 同构。在没有节点特征的情况下，GNN 学习到相同的节点表示，从而使节点对 (h1, t) 与节点对 (h2, t) 得到相同的链接表示。事实上，二者结果不应相同。节点 h2 与 t 共享一个共同邻居，这表明它们之间存在链接的概率更高。我们认为，GAEs 之所以从根本上失效，是因为它们在编码阶段专注于捕获以节点为中心的邻居信息，而未能感知目标节点对之间的结构关系。

blocks.text: Recently, some works have attempted to address this issue by node labeling tricks. For example, ID-GNN (You et al. 2021) colors target nodes to distinguish them from neighbor nodes, and SEAL (Zhang and Chen 2018; Zhang et al. 2021) calculates DRNL (Double-Radius Node Labeling) of all nodes in an enclosing subgraph. However, these approaches only help perceive path depth, while lacking perception of path ’width’, such as node degree or the number of paths. Moreover, they are still limited by the MP paradigm of GNNs, leading to shortcomings in terms of information perception and transmission for link prediction. On one hand, the way of neighbor node labeling converging to target nodes and then aggregating into relationship representations is implicit and convoluted, potentially risking information loss. On the other hand, the receptive field of GNNs may not be sufficient enough for link prediction.
blocks.translated: 最近，一些工作试图通过节点标记技巧来解决这一问题。例如，ID-GNN (You et al. 2021) 对目标节点进行着色以将其与邻居节点区分开，而 SEAL（Zhang and Chen 2018; Zhang et al. 2021）计算包围子图中所有节点的 DRNL（Double-Radius Node Labeling）。然而，这些方法仅有助于感知路径深度，而缺乏对路径“宽度”（如节点度或路径数量）的感知。此外，它们仍受限于 GNN 的 MP 范式，导致在链接预测的信息感知与传递方面存在不足。一方面，邻居节点标记汇聚到目标节点并随后聚合为关系表示的方式是隐式且迂回的，可能存在信息损失的风险。另一方面，GNN 的感受野对于链接预测可能不够充分。

blocks.text: GNNs are node-centric models, whose receptive field is the neighborhood of a central node. However, some target nodes in link prediction may be far apart, and GNNs struggle to capture the long-range information between them. The right part of Fig. 1 shows a simple example, where neither ID-GNN nor SEAL with the most commonly used 3-layer GNNs can distinguish between the two link structures shown in (b) and (c). When computing the representation of the head nodes h using GNNs, the computational graphs (including nodes’ DRNL) in both structures are the same, as shown in (d), and the color of tail nodes t are not aggregated. The same applies when computing the representation of the tail nodes t. Therefore, the two link structures cannot be distinguished by 3-layer GNNs, even with labeling tricks. To enhance the long-range information capturing ability of GNNs, the number of GNN layers needs to be increased to expand the receptive field, which, however, may lead to problems such as oversmoothing and overfitting (Li, Han, and Wu 2018; Rong et al. 2020).
blocks.translated: 图神经网络是节点中心模型，其感受野为中心节点的邻域。然而，链接预测中的某些目标节点可能相距较远，图神经网络难以捕获它们之间的长程信息。Fig. 1右侧展示了一个简单示例，其中 ID-GNN 和采用最常用 3 层图神经网络的 SEAL 均无法区分 (b) 和 (c) 所示的两种链接结构。使用图神经网络计算头节点 h 的表示时，两种结构中的计算图（包括节点的 DRNL）相同，如 (d) 所示，且尾节点 t 的颜色未被聚合。计算尾节点 t 的表示时同样如此。因此，即使采用节点标记技巧，3 层图神经网络也无法区分这两种链接结构。为增强图神经网络捕获长程信息的能力，需要增加图神经网络层数以扩大感受野，然而这可能导致过平滑和过拟合等问题（Li, Han, and Wu 2018; Rong et al. 2020）。

blocks.text: In this paper, we propose an additional attention module to compensate for the lack of GNN in capturing pairwise structures and directly learn relationship representations between target nodes. Self-attention is a powerful mechanism to learn pairwise relationships and shines brightly in Transformers (Vaswani et al. 2017), but it lacks the ability to perceive structures of elements. In addition, the computation is performed pairwise between all elements, resulting in a quadratic computational complexity and a large number of parameters leading to the problem of data hungry (Hassani et al. 2021). In order to capture the pairwise structural features of target nodes, we introduce the topological encoding to encode pairwise heuristics such as shortest path distance (SPD), Adamic-Adar, etc., and fuse them into attention. Besides, our encoding target is not the global information, but rather the pairwise structures of target nodes missed by GNNs. Therefore, we restrict attention computation to the target nodes, avoiding expensive computations and the risk of introducing noise from other nodes. As a result, the proposed attention module focuses on the target nodes and effectively encodes structural features, which we refer to as Binary Structural Attention (BSA).
blocks.translated: 本文中，我们提出一个额外的注意力模块，以补偿GNN在捕获成对结构方面的不足，并直接学习目标节点之间的关系表示。自注意力是一种学习成对关系的有力机制，在Transformers (Vaswani et al. 2017) 中表现突出，但它缺乏感知元素结构的能力。此外，计算是在所有元素之间成对进行的，导致二次计算复杂度和大量参数，进而产生数据饥饿问题 (Hassani et al. 2021)。为了捕获目标节点的成对结构特征，我们引入拓扑编码来编码最短路径距离（SPD）、Adamic-Adar等成对启发式，并将其融合到注意力中。此外，我们的编码目标不是全局信息，而是GNN遗漏的目标节点成对结构。因此，我们将注意力计算限制在目标节点上，避免昂贵的计算以及从其他节点引入噪声的风险。由此，所提出的注意力模块聚焦于目标节点并有效编码结构特征，我们将其称为二元结构注意力（BSA）。

blocks.text: Based on the above, we propose a Structural Information Enhanced Graph representation framework for link prediction (SIEG). On one hand, we use a GNN to collect the neighborhood information of target nodes, removing neighbor node features to make the model more focused on structural features. On the other hand, the BSA is introduced to encode the pairwise features of the target nodes, especially the long-range structural features, to complement the deficiency of GNN. Our method shows remarkable performance on six popular benchmarks, including ranking first on ogblppa, ogbl-citation2 and Pubmed.
blocks.translated: 基于上述内容，我们提出了一个用于链接预测的结构信息增强图表示框架（SIEG）。一方面，我们使用GNN收集目标节点的邻域信息，去除邻居节点特征以使模型更关注结构特征。另一方面，引入BSA对目标节点的成对特征进行编码，尤其是长程结构特征，以弥补GNN的不足。我们的方法在六个常用基准数据集上展现出显著性能，包括在ogblppa、ogbl-citation2和Pubmed上排名第一。

blocks.text: Related Works
blocks.translated: 相关工作

blocks.text: Link Prediction. There are four main paradigms of existing works on link prediction: walk-based methods, shallow Knowledge Graph Embedding methods (shallow-KGEs), path-based methods, and GNN-based methods. Walk-based methods take the random walk sequence from a node as the representation of it, whose representatives are Deep-Walk (Perozzi, Al-Rfou, and Skiena 2014) and Node2Vec (Grover and Leskovec 2016). Shallow-KGEs focus more on the triple relationship of head node, edge, and tail node, including TransE (Bordes et al. 2013), DistMult (Yang et al. 2014), and ubsequent works (Trouillon et al. 2016; Sun et al. 2019; Zhang et al. 2020b) improving score functions. However, these methods lack inductive properties and parameter sharing mechanisms, making them difficult to apply to large and scalable graphs. Path-based methods focus on connectivity between target nodes, including heuristic methods such as SPD and Katz (Katz 1953), rule-based approaches like NeuralLP (Yang, Yang, and Cohen 2017) and DRUM (Sadeghian et al. 2019), path representation methods such as Path-RNN (Neelakantan, Roth, and Mccallum 2015) and others (Wang, Ren, and Leskovec 2020; Zhu et al. 2021; Kong, Chen, and Zhang 2023). Among them, the heuristic methods are simple, interpretable, and inductive, making them suitable as structural features in our BSA.
blocks.translated: 链接预测。现有链接预测工作主要有四种范式：基于游走的方法、浅层知识图谱嵌入方法（shallow-KGEs）、基于路径的方法和基于GNN的方法。基于游走的方法将节点的随机游走序列作为其表示，代表方法有Deep-Walk（Perozzi, Al-Rfou, and Skiena 2014）和Node2Vec (Grover and Leskovec 2016)。浅层KGEs更关注头节点、边和尾节点的三元组关系，包括TransE (Bordes et al. 2013)、DistMult (Yang et al. 2014)，以及改进评分函数的后续工作（Trouillon et al. 2016; Sun et al. 2019; Zhang et al. 2020b）。然而，这些方法缺乏归纳特性和参数共享机制，难以应用于大规模可扩展图。基于路径的方法关注目标节点之间的连通性，包括SPD和Katz (Katz 1953)等启发式方法、NeuralLP（Yang, Yang, and Cohen 2017）和DRUM (Sadeghian et al. 2019)等基于规则的方法、Path-RNN（Neelakantan, Roth, and Mccallum 2015）等路径表示方法以及其他工作（Wang, Ren, and Leskovec 2020; Zhu et al. 2021; Kong, Chen, and Zhang 2023）。其中，启发式方法简单、可解释且具有归纳性，适合作为我们BSA中的结构特征。

blocks.text: Due to good performance and efficiency, GNN-based methods have become the mainstream approach for link prediction. Prevalent methods (Kipf and Welling 2016b; Vashishth et al. 2019; Ahn and Kim 2021) adopt an Autoencoder framework, where GNN serves as the encoder for node representations and edges are decoded as a function over node pairs. Another stream of frameworks, including SEAL (Zhang and Chen 2018), IGMC (Zhang and Chen 2020), and GraIL (Teru, Denis, and Hamilton 2020), encodes the enclosing subgraph around each node pair for link prediction. However, a good node-level representation does not necessarily lead to a good link-level representation (Zhang et al. 2021). Methods (You et al. 2021; Zhang et al. 2021) bridges the gap between node-level and edge-level GNN expressiveness with labeling tricks. However, they are still constrained by the MP paradigm of GNNs, unable to capture comprehensive long-range structures directly.
blocks.translated: 由于性能与效率良好，基于GNN的方法已成为链接预测的主流方法。主流方法（Kipf and Welling 2016b; Vashishth et al. 2019; Ahn and Kim 2021）采用自编码器框架，其中GNN作为节点表示的编码器，而边则被解码为节点对上的函数。另一类框架，包括SEAL (Zhang and Chen 2018)、IGMC (Zhang and Chen 2020)和GraIL（Teru, Denis, and Hamilton 2020），对每个节点对周围的包围子图进行编码以用于链接预测。然而，良好的节点级表示并不必然带来良好的链接级表示 (Zhang et al. 2021)。一些方法（You et al. 2021; Zhang et al. 2021）通过标记技巧弥合了节点级与边级GNN表达能力之间的差距。然而，它们仍受制于GNN的消息传递范式，无法直接捕获全面的长程结构。

blocks.text: Graph Transformer. Transformer has achieved great success in Natural Language Processing (Vaswani et al. 2017) and Computer Vision (Dosovitskiy et al. 2021), and its application to graph has also emerged. The Transformer faces two main challenges when applied to graph data: position/structure encoding and computational complexity. Firstly, the core module of Transformer, Self-attention, lacks the ability to perceive the structural information of targets. To address this, some methods have introduced additional encoding schemes, such as Laplacian encoding (Dwivedi and Bresson 2020), distance correlation encoding (Ying et al. 2021; Mialon et al. 2021), and structure-aware encoding (Chen, O’Bray, and Borgwardt 2022; Park et al. 2022), while some works propose specialized networks to learn positional encoding (Kreuzer et al. 2021). In order to capture the pairwise structural features of target nodes in BSA, we extend the topological encoding (Park et al. 2022) to encode pairwise heuristics and fuse them into attention.
blocks.translated: Graph Transformer。Transformer 已在自然语言处理(Vaswani et al. 2017)和计算机视觉(Dosovitskiy et al. 2021)中取得巨大成功，其在图上的应用也已出现。Transformer 应用于图数据时面临两个主要挑战：位置/结构编码与计算复杂度。首先，Transformer 的核心模块自注意力（Self-attention）缺乏感知目标结构信息的能力。为解决该问题，一些方法引入了额外的编码方案，例如拉普拉斯编码(Dwivedi and Bresson 2020)、距离相关编码（Ying et al. 2021; Mialon et al. 2021）以及结构感知编码（Chen, O’Bray, and Borgwardt 2022; Park et al. 2022），而一些工作则提出专门的网络来学习位置编码(Kreuzer et al. 2021)。为了在 BSA 中捕获目标节点的成对结构特征，我们将拓扑编码(Park et al. 2022)扩展为编码成对启发式信息，并将其融合到注意力机制中。

blocks.text: In addition, Self-attention calculates the similarity between all nodes pairwise, resulting in a quadratic computational complexity. To alleviate this problem, methods (Dwivedi and Bresson 2020; Zhang et al. 2020a) limit the number of nodes involved in computation through sampling. However, the sampling strategies are still node-centric rather than link-centric. For BSA, the encoding target is specifically the pairwise structures of target nodes in link prediction. Therefore, we restrict attention computation to the target nodes, avoiding the quadratic computations.
blocks.translated: 此外，自注意力会成对计算所有节点之间的相似度，从而导致二次计算复杂度。为缓解该问题，一些方法（Dwivedi and Bresson 2020; Zhang et al. 2020a）通过采样限制参与计算的节点数量。然而，这些采样策略仍然是节点中心的，而非链接中心的。对于 BSA，其编码目标具体是链接预测中目标节点的成对结构。因此，我们将注意力计算限制在目标节点上，从而避免二次计算。

blocks.text: Doubt Neighbors. A few works have raised doubts about neighbors in graph learning. Feng et al. (Feng et al. 2021) suggests that some of the neighbors in GNN aggregation may be unreliable and misleading. While GraphENS (Park, Song, and Yang 2022) have found that models tend to overfit to neighbor sets of minor class in class-imbalanced node classification. However, there is no research questioning the necessity of neighbor node features in link prediction, to the best of our knowledge.
blocks.translated: 质疑邻居。已有少数研究对图学习中的邻居提出了质疑。Feng等人(Feng et al. 2021)指出，GNN聚合中的部分邻居可能不可靠且具有误导性。而GraphENS（Park, Song, and Yang 2022）发现，在类别不平衡的节点分类中，模型倾向于对少数类的邻居集合过拟合。然而，据我们所知，尚无研究对链接预测中邻居节点特征的必要性提出质疑。

blocks.text: Methodology
blocks.translated: 方法论

blocks.text: Problem Definition. Assuming a graph is denoted as G = (V, E, A), where V , E are the set of nodes and the set of edges, respectively, and A is the adjacency matrix of the graph. Node feature matrix is denoted as X ∈ R|V |×D, where D is the dimension of node features. The goal of link prediction is to predict whether there exists an edge ei,j between two given nodes (vi, vj), according to the graph. Overall Architecture. As it is shown in Fig. 2, the proposed link prediction framework consists of four main parts: subgraph sampling, structural information enhanced GNN for neighborhood structure encoding, Binary Structural Transformer (BST) for pairwise structure encoding, and link decoding.
blocks.translated: 问题定义。假设图表示为 G = (V, E, A)，其中 V、E 分别为节点集和边集，A 为图的邻接矩阵。节点特征矩阵表示为 X ∈ R^{|V|×D}，其中 D 为节点特征的维度。链接预测的目标是根据该图预测给定两个节点 (vi, vj) 之间是否存在边 ei,j。整体架构。如Fig. 2所示，所提出的链接预测框架由四个主要部分组成：子图采样、用于邻域结构编码的结构信息增强 GNN、用于成对结构编码的 Binary Structural Transformer（BST），以及链接解码。

blocks.text: Subgraph Sampling
blocks.translated: 子图采样

blocks.text: Given a target node pair (vi, vj), we sample a k-hop enclosing subgraph (Zhang and Chen 2017) around it. This subgraph is composed of the union of the two k-hop subgraphs around each target node, with edges between the two subgraphs also being incorporated. For instance, in Fig. 2, an additional edge e1,5 beyond 1-hop is included in the 1-hop enclosing subgraph of target node pair (h, t). Enclosing subgraphs provide better connectivity and more informative input for link prediction than normal subgraphs. It has been proved in WLNM (Zhang and Chen 2017) that not only first and second-order heuristic features can be directly calculated in enclosing subgraph, but even high-order heuristics are also feasible with a small number of hops.
blocks.translated: 给定一个目标节点对 (vi, vj)，我们在其周围采样一个 k 跳包围子图 (Zhang and Chen 2017)。该子图由两个目标节点各自的 k 跳子图的并集构成，并且两个子图之间的边也被纳入其中。例如，在 Fig. 2 中，目标节点对 (h, t) 的 1 跳包围子图里包含了一条超出 1 跳的额外边 e1,5。与普通子图相比，包围子图能够为链接预测提供更好的连通性和更具信息量的输入。WLNM (Zhang and Chen 2017) 已证明，在包围子图中不仅可以直接计算一阶和二阶启发式特征，即使高阶启发式特征也只需少量跳数即可实现。

blocks.text: Pairwise Structure Encoding
blocks.translated: 成对结构编码

blocks.text: As we analyzed in the Introduction section, even with labeling tricks, the GNN framework has two limitations for link prediction: the absence of long-range structural information due to restricted receptive fields and the conflict between node-centric models and link-centric tasks. To address these shortcomings, we propose the BST to capture pairwise structures and feature similarities between target nodes exclusively, representing relations directly and supplementing the limitations of GNNs.
blocks.translated: 正如我们在引言部分所分析的，即使采用标记技巧，图神经网络（GNN）框架在链接预测方面仍存在两个局限：由于感受野受限而缺乏长程结构信息，以及节点中心模型与链接中心任务之间的冲突。为解决这些不足，我们提出 BST，以专门捕获目标节点之间的成对结构和特征相似性，直接表示关系并弥补 GNN 的局限性。

blocks.text: The proposed BST offers several advantages over the regular Transformer. Firstly, the potential noise and overfitting risk introduced by nodes away from the targets are avoided. Secondly, more task-relevant structure information is collected. Finally, computational complexity is greatly reduced.
blocks.translated: 所提出的 BST 相较常规 Transformer 具有若干优势。首先，避免了远离目标的节点所引入的潜在噪声和过拟合风险。其次，收集了更多与任务相关的结构信息。最后，计算复杂度大幅降低。

blocks.text: Link Decoding
blocks.translated: 链接解码

blocks.text: Generally, neighborhood embedding and pairwise embedding can be fused with any specifically designed technique to achieve a good link prediction result. As the focus of our study is not on fusion techniques, we simply concatenate the embeddings to form the relation representation and decode it into a link score with Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP). This process is formulated as scoreij = MLP(hGNNij ∥ hBSTij).
blocks.translated: 一般来说，邻域嵌入与成对嵌入可以采用任意专门设计的技术进行融合，以获得良好的链接预测结果。由于我们的研究重点并非融合技术，因此我们简单地将嵌入拼接起来构成关系表示，并用多层感知机（MLP）将其解码为链接得分。该过程可表述为 scoreij = MLP(hGNNij ∥ hBSTij)。

blocks.text: Where hGNNij is the similarity embedding of target nodes encoded by GNN, while hBSTij is the relation embedding encoded by BST, and ∥ denotes the concatenation operation.
blocks.translated: 其中 hGNNij 是由 GNN 编码的目标节点的相似性嵌入，而 hBSTij 是由 BST 编码的关系嵌入，∥ 表示拼接操作。

blocks.text: Computational Complexity
blocks.translated: 计算复杂度

blocks.text: In comparison to FCA, BSA achieves a significant reduction in computational complexity. FCA entails two main computational costs: SPD searching and Attention calculation, with complexities of O(N(N + E) log N) (Dijkstra 1959) and O(N2D + ND2), respectively. Here, N and E denote the number of nodes and edges in the subgraph, and D denotes the dimension of node features. In contrast, the computational complexity of BSA is much lower than that of FCA, as indicated in Table 2, with only O((N + E) log N) for SPD and O(D2) for Attention.
blocks.translated: 与FCA相比，BSA在计算复杂度上实现了显著降低。FCA包含两项主要计算开销：SPD搜索与注意力机制计算，其复杂度分别为O(N(N + E) log N) (Dijkstra 1959)和O(N2D + ND2)。其中，N和E分别表示子图中的节点数与边数，D表示节点特征的维度。相比之下，BSA的计算复杂度远低于FCA，如Table 2所示，其SPD仅为O((N + E) log N)，注意力机制为O(D2)。

blocks.text: The overall computational cost of the Transformer is proportional to the sum of the computational cost of SPD and Attention. Consequently, the acceleration ratio from fullyconnected Transformer (FCT) to BST ranges from N to N2, which can be approximated to N or N2 when N ≪ D or N ≫ D respectively. BST effectively addresses the computationally expensive nature of the Transformer in link prediction, enabling SIEG to be applied on larger-scale datasets.
blocks.translated: Transformer 的整体计算开销与 SPD 和注意力机制的计算开销之和成正比。因此，从全连接 Transformer（FCT）到 BST 的加速比介于 N 到 N2 之间，当 N ≪ D 或 N ≫ D 时，该加速比可分别近似为 N 或 N2。BST 有效解决了 Transformer 在链接预测中计算代价高昂的问题，使 SIEG 能够应用于更大规模的数据集。

blocks.text: Expressive Power
blocks.translated: 表达能力

blocks.text: The Weisfeiler-Lehman test (Weisfeiler and Leman 1968) is a widely used graph isomorphism test, and it has been proven (Xu et al. 2018) that the expressive power of Message Passing GNNs (MPGNNs), such as GCN, GraphSAGE, and GAT, is upper-bounded by the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Lehman (1-WL) algorithm. Specifically, the 1-WL algorithm cannot distinguish nodes with the same subtrees but different substructures. Consequently, the GAEs based on MPGNNs cannot distinguish link structures involving these target nodes. In contrast, the proposed SIEG is able to effectively distinguish such structures by providing distinct representations, even beyond receptive fields of GNNs. This implies that SIEG surpasses the 1-WL test and overcomes the message passing limitation of GNNs. The detailed proof is presented in the Appendix.
blocks.translated: Weisfeiler-Lehman 检验 (Weisfeiler and Leman 1968) 是一种广泛使用的图同构检验，并且已被证明 (Xu et al. 2018)：消息传递 GNN（MPGNN），如 GCN、GraphSAGE 和 GAT，其表达能力上界为 1 维 Weisfeiler-Lehman（1-WL）算法。具体而言，1-WL 算法无法区分具有相同子树但不同子结构的节点。因此，基于 MPGNN 的 GAE 无法区分涉及这些目标节点的链接结构。相比之下，所提出的 SIEG 能够通过提供不同的表示来有效区分此类结构，甚至超越 GNN 的感受野。这意味着 SIEG 超越了 1-WL 检验，并克服了 GNN 的消息传递局限。详细证明见附录。

blocks.text: Comparison with Baselines. Table 3 reports the performance of the proposed method, SIEG with and without neighbor features (w/and w/o NF), and baselines on three OGB benchmarks. All results of the baselines are taken from the OGB leaderboards2. Table 4 presents the performance of SIEG and baselines on the Classic datasets, with results of the baselines being taken from the corresponding papers. The proposed method achieves competitive results for all datasets, including ranking first on ogbl-ppa, ogbl-citation2, and Pubmed. (Note that the first place on ogbl-vessel, GAV (Wittmann et al. 2023), is specifically designed for flowdriven spatial networks rather than general graphs and is therefore not included as a baseline.) Compared to smaller or sparser graphs, the advantage of SIEG is more pronounced on larger or denser ones (statistics for each dataset are provided in the Appendix). One possible explanation for this is that larger graphs may contain more long-range target node pairs, while denser graphs could introduce more noise from neighbor features, which SIEG is designed to address. Notably, SIEG w/o NF performs better than SIEG w/NF on all datasets, and we discuss this, along with other module comparisons, in the Ablation Study paragraph below.

blocks.text: Primarily, we analyze intra-category results based on SIEG w/o NF. Adding neighbor features (SIEG w/ NF) leads to worse performance, consistent with the results of GNN alone in Table 1. This confirms our suspicion that neighbor features are not effective features for link prediction or introduce noise. Besides, removing BST (SIEG w/o BST) leads to a drop in performance, indicating that BST learns important features missed by GNN, particularly pairwise structural features. In SIEG (FCT) category, adding neighbor features and removing GNN based on SIEG (FCT) w/o NF lead to drops, while removing FCT leads to a rise. This suggests that FCT negatively impacts link prediction on top of GNN, despite capturing pairwise structures, like BST. What causes this damage?
blocks.translated: 首先，我们基于 SIEG w/o NF 分析类内结果。添加邻居节点特征（SIEG w/ NF）会导致性能下降，这与 Table 1 中仅使用 GNN 的结果一致。这证实了我们的推测：邻居节点特征并非链接预测的有效特征，或者会引入噪声。此外，移除 BST（SIEG w/o BST）会导致性能下降，这表明 BST 学到了 GNN 所遗漏的重要特征，尤其是成对结构特征。在 SIEG (FCT) 类别中，基于 SIEG (FCT) w/o NF 添加邻居节点特征和移除 GNN 都会导致性能下降，而移除 FCT 则会导致性能上升。这表明，尽管 FCT 像 BST 一样能够捕获成对结构，但它在 GNN 基础上会对链接预测产生负面影响。是什么造成了这种损害？

blocks.text: Here, we analyze the cross-category results by comparing each model of SIEG with the corresponding model of SIEG (FCT). We find that replacing BST with FCT results in a drop in all models, which supports the conclusion analyzed in the Methodology section. FCT introduces a large amount information away from the targets, which may lead to potential noise or overfitting risks.
blocks.translated: 这里，我们通过将 SIEG 的每个模型与 SIEG（FCT）的对应模型进行比较，来分析跨类别结果。我们发现，用 FCT 替换 BST 会导致所有模型出现性能下降，这支持了方法部分所分析的结论。FCT 引入了大量远离目标的信息，这可能带来潜在的噪声或过拟合风险。

blocks.text: Computational Efficiency. We present the Time consumption results of SIEG and SIEG (FCT) on a small dataset (Cora) and a medium-size dataset (ogbl-citation2) in Fig. 3. As theoretically analyzed in the Methodology section, the computational cost ratio between FCT and BST ranges from N to N2. Experimentally, the results on Cora show that SIEG w/o NF runs 10 times faster than SIEG (FCT) w/o NF, and SIEG w/o GNN runs 16 times faster than SIEG (FCT) w/o GNN, demonstrating the significant efficiency advantage of BST over FCT. When dealing with medium-sized ogbl-citation2, models with FCT can hardly run.
blocks.translated: 计算效率。我们在 Fig. 3 中展示了 SIEG 和 SIEG (FCT) 在小数据集（Cora）和中等规模数据集（ogbl-citation2）上的时间消耗结果。正如在方法部分进行的理论分析，FCT 与 BST 之间的计算成本比值范围为 N 到 N2。实验结果表明，在 Cora 上，SIEG w/o NF 的运行速度比 SIEG (FCT) w/o NF 快 10 倍，SIEG w/o GNN 的运行速度比 SIEG (FCT) w/o GNN 快 16 倍，这证明了 BST 相较于 FCT 具有显著的效率优势。在处理中等规模的 ogbl-citation2 时，采用 FCT 的模型几乎无法运行。

blocks.text: Case Study. We use a simple example to illustrate how SIEG leverages pairwise structural features for link prediction. On Cora test set, SIEG assigns a high score of 8.22 to a positive publication pair with target node IDs (1111, 1273), and predictes a citation relationship between them. Examination of the pairwise structural features of this pair reveals a CN score of 4 and an AA score of 2.21, indicating the presence of 4 common citations who are not widely cited, which should be an important reason for SIEG to infer their citation relationship.
blocks.translated: 案例研究。我们用一个简单示例说明 SIEG 如何利用成对结构特征进行链接预测。在 Cora 测试集上，SIEG 对目标节点 ID 为（1111，1273）的正向论文对赋予 8.22 的高分，并预测二者之间存在引用关系。考察该论文对的成对结构特征可以发现，其 CN 得分为 4，AA 得分为 2.21，表明存在 4 个未被广泛引用的共同引用文献，这应是 SIEG 推断其引用关系的重要原因。

blocks.text: Conclusions
blocks.translated: 结论

blocks.text: In this paper, we theoretically analyze GNNs’ two inherent defects for link prediction in terms of information perception and transmission, and experimentally discover the harmful effects of neighbor node features. To address these issues, we propose a structural information enhanced link prediction framework, which involves removing the neighbor node features while fitting neighborhood structures more focused through GNN, and introducing BST to encode the structural relationships between target nodes, complementing the defects of GNN. The proposed method achieves remarkable results on six popular benchmarks, including ranking first on ogbl-ppa, ogbl-citation2 and Pubmed. Lastly, note that link prediction is a special case of multi-node representation learning, which also includes triplet (Liu, Ma, and Li 2021), motif (Besta et al. 2021), and subgraph (Alsentzer et al. 2020) tasks, among others. Theoretically, our method is also applicable to these tasks. In future work, we will practically extend SIEG to multiple tasks and develop it into a general multi-node representation learning framework.
blocks.translated: 本文从信息感知和信息传递两个方面理论分析了GNN在链接预测中的两个固有缺陷，并通过实验发现了邻居节点特征的有害影响。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种结构信息增强的链接预测框架，该框架包括去除邻居节点特征，同时通过GNN更集中地拟合邻域结构，并引入BST来编码目标节点之间的结构关系，以弥补GNN的缺陷。所提方法在六个常用基准数据集上取得了显著结果，包括在ogbl-ppa、ogbl-citation2和Pubmed上排名第一。最后，需要注意的是，链接预测是多节点表示学习的一个特例，多节点表示学习还包括三元组（Liu, Ma, and Li 2021）、模体(Besta et al. 2021)和子图(Alsentzer et al. 2020)等任务。理论上，我们的方法也适用于这些任务。在未来的工作中，我们将实际地将SIEG扩展到多个任务，并将其发展为一个通用的多节点表示学习框架。
